title: papaver croceum subsp. corydalifolium
intro: Papaver croceum subsp. corydalifolium, commonly known as Corydalis, is a type of flowering plant native to China. It is known for its health benefits, including reducing anxiety and stress, due to its sedative and anxiolytic properties. The therapeutic actions of Corydalis include its ability to interact with opioid receptors, providing relief from pain, and its potential to improve sleep quality. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as berberine, tetrahydropalmatine, and protopine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
